items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: isolated vehicle sprite for a small fixed-view parking website. Use the provided image as shape and vehicle-identity reference, not as a background. Produce ONE Xiaomi SU7, turquoise aqua body, low flowing fastback sedan, distinctive rounded triangular teardrop headlights with horizontal inner light bar, black glass roof, dark sporty alloy wheels, roof lidar. Faithful semi-realistic miniature/model-car appearance, very light simplification only, crisp detailed silhouette that reads at 180px. Front three-quarter view facing toward lower LEFT, camera elevated about 20 degrees so the hood and roof are visible; whole vehicle centered with generous margin, no cropping, all visible wheels grounded at consistent level. Preserve distinctive real vehicle geometry and proportions, clean softly lit product render. Transparent background with a restrained soft contact shadow only. No ground plane, scenery, frame, labels, captions, promotional logos outside the vehicle, or extra vehicles. This is a visual exploration derived from a reference; do not invent a 3D asset.
